original_test_intent: Validate the Starting Address of every SMBIOS Type 19 physical-memory-array mapped range using the correct legacy or extended encoding, paired range endpoints, array association and persistence after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 16/19/20 records and OS memory map, gate legacy versus Extended Starting Address by sentinel and structure length, normalize units, bind start to its ending address and array handle, validate the whole range map, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies the approved memory map/range policy and approves reboot; no memory remapping or physical operation is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version and Type 19 structure length
Legacy all-ones sentinel, Extended Starting/Ending Address and unit rules
Expected Type 19 ranges per Type 16 array including gap/overlap policy
Read-only OS/e820 or firmware memory-map correlation policy
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and OS memory-map queries; do not change kernel, DIMMs, memory map or firmware.
Evaluate start only with its paired end and the same legacy/extended selection; reject mixed sentinel use.
Preserve raw values and units before normalization and guard inclusive-end arithmetic/overflow.
Require reboot approval/OOB recovery; stop on invalid range or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse every Type 19 start with paired end/extended values, resolve Type 16 handle, normalize the complete range set and compare with Type 20/OS maps before and after reboot.
Report gaps, overlaps, inverted/mixed-mode ranges or drift without deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected ranges, reserved gaps, unit/sentinel and OS-correlation policy plus reboot plan.
Resolve intentional platform reservations versus mapping defects and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Starting Address is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot prove paired Ending/Extended fields, structure mode, units, range handle or map topology.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 16/19/20 and OS map; report each Type 19 handle, raw legacy/extended start/end, normalized inclusive range, array link, overlap/gap result and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 19 Starting Address scope, linked script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no memory-map change is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select legacy or extended addresses strictly from SMBIOS sentinel/length rules, normalize each Type 19 start with its paired end and array handle, validate the full non-overlapping map against approved Type 20/OS context, then compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS platforms exposing Type 19 mapped-address structures.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, dmidecode/parser and OS-map versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 19 legacy/extended address and Type 16/20 relationship definitions plus the approved platform map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds encoding-mode selection, endpoint pairing, full-range topology and cross-map correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects unit errors, mixed sentinels, inverted/overlapping ranges, invalid array links and map drift missed by isolated grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved map, reserved-gap and legacy/extended interpretation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS-visible maps include reservations and need not equal raw installed capacity; differences require policy rather than automatic failure.

project_override_considerations: Projects may approve topology-specific ranges and reserved gaps, but must retain raw Type 19 semantics; a different target map may override expected values, not the endpoint-pairing rules.
expected_evidence: Approved Type 19 range, sentinel/unit, gap/overlap and OS-correlation policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/19/20 records with structure lengths and versions
Per-range raw legacy/extended start/end, normalized inclusive range and array-handle resolution
Read-only OS/e820 map comparison with intentional reservations identified
Approved reboot/health evidence and complete post-reboot map diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Starting Address is a valid Type 19 field; expected platform ranges are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Encoding selection, range validation, handle resolution and persistence checks are software-automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds endpoint pairing, raw sentinel/extended handling, units, range identity and map topology.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its mapping and no-write safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates approved map/reboot readiness and engineer verdict from automation.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible start address from passing when paired with the wrong end, encoded in the wrong field, overlapping another range or linked to the wrong array.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Type 19 start has meaning only within its full range and handle topology; all required checks are deterministic read-only parsing and comparison.
